title: Period Homeostasis Near Hopf Bifurcation
summary: Homeostasis is a biological phenomenon in which a function of the state of the system remains approximately constant as an input parameter varies. Recent mathematical work has developed a framework for studying homeostasis using methods from singularity theory. In this framework, the requirement that the function of the state remain approximately constant is replaced by the condition that the derivative of the function with respect to the input parameter vanishes at an isolated point.
